jobs.title: Head of FP&A | Efficiency
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are seeking a Head of FP&A to lead our FP&A Efficiency agenda — driving and influencing the optimization of Nubank's global cost base. You will lead a core Financial Planning & Analysis team focused on cost management and partner closely with the business to build a culture of cost discipline and high-performance efficiency, treating every dollar as a source of competitive advantage rather than a back-office exercise. You will help owners identify strategic investments that support Nubank's future growth while maintaining a lean cost base — equipping partners with the rigorous planning, forecasting, and multidimensional analysis they need to drive decisions at the most senior levels.

This role is not about optimizing ratios in isolation; it is about helping engineer one of the most efficient financial engines in the industry. The scope is global and company-wide: you will lead all of Nubank's Global Opex and Capex — influencing US$5B+ yearly across the company — with a sharp, relentless focus on cost.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy across complex scenarios involving multiple teams, stakeholders, and areas of expertise. You will manage trade-offs, resource allocation, and cross-functional alignment while leading and developing a high-performing team. You will contribute to short-term (6–18 months) strategy building and cascade it into clear tactical plans, with consistent exposure to senior leadership.

This is a people-management role: you will lead, coach, and grow the team; shape its composition and priorities; and act as an effective change agent, guiding the area through organizational and business evolution.



YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 

 - Lead the planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting cycles for Nubank's Global Opex and Capex, providing business owners the visibility, planning discipline, and controls to manage their financials (budget, expenses, and contracts) and risk, with a sharp focus on cost efficiency and full accountability for the integrity of the numbers.

 - Drive the adoption of AI, advanced analytics, and automation to redefine financial processes, measuring rigorous KPIs to iterate and scale successes across the function.

 - Translate multi-dimensional data (operational, market, regulatory) into strategic insights, identifying trends and quantifying their expected impact on key business drivers.

 - Handle and support the team through problems and ambiguities, effectively managing trade-offs, resource allocation, and required alignments.

 - Manage large and/or multidisciplinary initiatives with consistent exposure to senior stakeholders, knowing when and how to escalate to direct managers and critical stakeholders.

 - Contribute to short-term (6–18 months) strategy building and cascade it into tactical plans.

 - Lead with a diverse range of perspectives, manage complex conflict as a mediator, and influence company-wide decisions — knowing when to disagree and when to commit and guiding the team to move things forward.

 


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO HAS

Required

 - Analytical ability — you analyze complex, multi-dimensional data sets to generate strategic insights, synthesize cross-functional information into clear guidance, and communicate findings with authority that influences senior stakeholders.

 - Strategic acumen — you leverage broad knowledge of business drivers and interdependencies to develop scalable solutions, consider emerging industry trends and regulatory changes, and prioritize initiatives for long-term value creation, even when this requires short-term trade-offs.

 - Financial expertise — deep mastery of financial analysis, planning, accounting and reporting, controls and compliance, and modeling and valuation, with the ability to design frameworks that enhance predictive accuracy and business agility.

 - Communication — you communicate complex messages clearly and persuasively, adapt your style across audiences and cultures, promote productive idea exchange, and listen actively.

 - Stakeholder management — you map and navigate key stakeholders, build productive and trust-based relationships, and proactively influence stakeholders to gain buy-in, resolve conflicts, and adjust priorities when needed.

 - Agile adaptability — you anticipate and navigate complex problems, develop innovative solutions that address root causes, and lead experimentation that delivers high-impact value.

 - Technology & AI fluency — you guide teams in applying advanced analytics and visualization, lead the implementation of AI solutions and automations that optimize business processes, and drive AI initiatives that map to core business goals.

 - Leadership — you lead, coach, and develop people, build strong and diverse teams, and act as an effective change agent.

Qualifications

 - Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Engineering, Business, or a related field; advanced degree or relevant certification (e.g., CFA) is a plus.

 - Extensive experience in FP&A, corporate finance, accounting, or a closely related function, including significant experience leading and developing teams.

 - Proven track record of owning financial planning, forecasting, and performance management for a business area or function.

 - Strong command of financial modeling, valuation, and advanced data analysis; proficiency with modern analytics and visualization tools.

 - Experience influencing and partnering with senior leadership on strategic decisions.

 - Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, manage complex trade-offs, and drive change across cross-functional and multidisciplinary environments.

 - Fluency in English; additional languages are a plus.

 


WORK SETUP 

Location

São Paulo, Brasil

Work model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

2-3 days per week at the office.

Enterprise Risk Management Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en

About the Team

The Enterprise Risk Management squad sets the global standards for how Nubank identifies, assesses and manages risk across the enterprise – spanning operational, compliance, technology, conduct and other non‑financial risks, and strongly interfacing with financial risk areas (credit, market, liquidity, capital, treasury).

As part of the ERM Methodology Team, you will sit at the intersection of risk, product and platform: shaping global frameworks, embedding them into data and systems, and scaling them with AI‑enabled workflows so that ERM becomes both a competitive advantage and an enabler of safe growth across products, portfolios and geographies. You will be a reference for methodology decisions, influencing senior stakeholders across multiple lines of defense and risk types.

What you'll do

 - Own the end‑to‑end design and evolution of ERM methodologies, ensuring coherence across programs and geographies.

 - Ensure ERM methodologies connect across risk types (e.g., operational, compliance, technology, conduct, model, financial/credit where relevant) and support a consistent view of the risk profile.

 - Translate methodological requirements into GRC platform, product and data specifications, partnering with Platform and engineering teams to build scalable, intuitive workflows.

 - Lead the global standardization of global ERM methodologies while enabling smart local adaptations to meet regulatory expectations in each geo.

 - Design and drive the integration of ERM programs in new geos, ensuring that new launches start already aligned with group‑level risk standards and governance.

 - Define and embed AI/agent use‑cases into ERM workflows (e.g., risk/control suggestions, narrative pre‑population, quality checks), with clear human‑in‑the‑loop governance.

 - Use AI and analytics to monitor quality and consistency of methodologies, surfacing insights and opportunities for continuous improvement.

 - Partner with risk leaders (financial and non-financial risks), CRO teams, risk stewards and 1LOD to ensure strong adoption and practical usability of ERM frameworks in day‑to‑day decision making.

 - Represent ERM methodologies in governance and decision forums.

 - Create and refine key risk and performance indicators for ERM programs, enabling better visibility on program effectiveness, maturity and trends.

 - Communicate clearly and regularly about ERM methodology initiatives and projects with a wide variety of stakeholders (risk teams in different countries, financial risk functions, internal audit, leadership, product and platform).

What we're looking for:

 - Solid experience in Enterprise Risk / Operational Risk / Non‑Financial Risk, with hands‑on ownership of at least one major program or framework (RCSA, control testing, Issue Management, NP&F or equivalent enterprise‑level framework).

 - Proven track record as a senior individual contributor leading complex risk initiatives end‑to‑end, from design to rollout, with limited oversight.

 - Experience working in multi‑geo or global environments, balancing global standards with local regulatory expectations.

 - Strong ability to translate risk methodologies into systems and data (platform requirements, data models, workflow design) in partnership with engineering and product.

 - Demonstrated stakeholder management and influence without formal authority, especially across product, risk, compliance and platform/engineering teams.

 - Comfort working with data and analytics (e.g., querying datasets, interpreting dashboards, defining metrics) to guide decisions on methodology and program performance.

 - Experience defining and tracking metrics, SLAs and KPIs for risk/controls or governance processes.

 - Strong written and verbal communication in English, including the ability to explain complex risk concepts to non‑experts.

Nice to Have

 - Prior experience in ERM, operational risk, internal controls in financial services or fintech.

 - Previous work in designing frameworks, methodologies and governance for risk (financial and/or non‑financial), influencing multiple lines of defense and senior stakeholders across geos.

 - Exposure to AI/ML or advanced analytics applied to risk, controls, data quality or governance (e.g., LLMs, anomaly detection, smart suggestions).

 - Experience working closely with platform / GRC / risk systems (e.g., JIRA‑based workflows, custom risk platforms, governance tooling).

 - Familiarity with regulatory expectations for risks and governance in Brazil and/or other key markets, including reading requirements and translating them into practical frameworks.

 - Background in high‑growth tech/fintech environments, navigating the tension between speed, innovation and robust risk management.

jobs.title: AI and Agentic AI Risk Management Senior Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


About the team
At Nubank we heavily rely on Data, Machine Learning, and increasingly on Generative and Agentic AI to drive our strategy and deliver the best experience and products to our customers. The Model Risk team plays a crucial role in ensuring the risks associated with our models and AI systems are understood and under control. We are now building a dedicated AI Risk Management capability to address the emerging risks of advanced AI — including LLM-powered and autonomous agentic systems — with a focus on AI quality, model and agent behavior, and the platform controls that keep these systems safe and reliable across internal and customer-facing use cases.

About the role 
This is a senior, hands-on technical position. You will help define what model risk management looks like for AI and Agentic AI at Nubank — building and enhancing the frameworks, not just inheriting them. You will perform independent assessments of AI systems for quality, behavior, and robustness, and help design the guardrails and platform-level controls that govern their safe use. You'll act as a credible technical peer to first-line engineering and AI development teams, providing practical guidance on AI risk without slowing responsible innovation. This role focuses on AI quality, agentic behavior, and platform controls; cybersecurity, data privacy, and fraud-specific matters sit with partner functions and are out of scope.

What you will do

AI Risk Framework & Governance

 - Build and continuously enhance the risk management framework for AI and Agentic AI systems, including inventory standards, assessment methodologies, control design, and issue management.

 - Inventory and map Nubank's AI use cases to surface gaps, materiality, and the most critical risks, and define prioritized mitigation actions.

 - Assess whether first-line monitoring is effective, proportionate to model risk, and sufficient to keep AI systems fit for purpose over time.

Independent AI Assessment

 - Perform independent technical assessments across generative AI, and agentic workflows, covering data, assumptions, methodology, testing, behavior, and monitoring.

 - Assess risks in LLM-powered applications, including RAG pipelines, tool use, autonomy boundaries, model/agent quality, human oversight, and hallucination risk.

 - Identify and document model limitations, failure modes, and emerging AI risks, including drift, instability, fairness, and robustness concerns.

Controls, Platform & Enablement

 - Influence first-line teams on platform architecture and embedded controls for the safe deployment and monitoring of AI.

 - Build Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and metrics for continuous monitoring of AI risk.

 - Develop tools, evals, analyses, and playbooks (including AI-enabled automation) to improve the speed, scale, and effectiveness of AI governance and validation.

Advisory & Advocacy

 - Serve as a trusted advisor across the AI/ML lifecycle, evaluating new use cases for materiality and governance requirements prior to deployment.

 - Discuss and report AI risk status and independent opinions to stakeholders, including senior managers and, where relevant, regulators.

 - Champion AI risk management as a strategic enabler of safe and scalable AI adoption, and build AI risk literacy across engineering, product, and risk teams.

 - Work in a multicultural, diverse, and highly skilled environment.

Requirements we are looking for

 - Education: A bachelor's or master's degree in a quantitative field (computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, engineering, or related).

 - Hands-on AI/ML experience: A track record developing or validating AI/ML models and systems, ideally a candidate who has moved from an AI / Machine Learning Engineer background into model risk, governance, or risk management. You don't need to have trained foundation models from scratch, but you need solid, current technical depth.

 - Strong technical foundations: Proficiency in Python, SQL, and modern ML tooling; familiarity with LLMs, RAG systems, prompt engineering, and AI agent frameworks.

 - Evaluation and testing: Experience evaluating and testing ML and generative AI systems, including custom evals, benchmarking, stress testing, and drift/degradation monitoring.

 - Risk management experience: Demonstrated experience in risk identification, control definition, and framework building; understanding of model risk governance principles and independent effective challenge.

 - Data skills: Experience working with large datasets and building dashboards and analyses to support risk visibility.

 - High agency and adaptability: Comfortable operating in ambiguity, synthesizing fragmented technical and business context into a clear view of how complex AI systems actually work, and making sound judgments without a complete playbook.

 - Influencing skills: Able to engage and align stakeholders across first and second lines of defense as a credible technical peer.

 - Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, you can explain AI risk to a data scientist and to a regulator, and use different language for each.

 - Advanced or fluent English: You will meet with partners and stakeholders across countries and prepare documentation and presentations in English.

 - PLUS: Experience in a 2nd or 3rd line of defense.

 - PLUS: Familiarity with regulatory Model Risk Management and AI frameworks (e.g., SR 11-7 / SR 26-2 / OCC 2011-12, NIST AI RMF, EU AI Act).

 

Total compensation includes base salary, RSUs and benefits. Base salary range: US$108k - US$131k.

Benefits

 - Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

 - Medical Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance

 - Life Insurance and AD&D

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

 - Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

 - NuLanguage - Our language learning program

 - Extended maternity and paternity leaves 

 - 401K

 - Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.


WORK MODEL FOR THIS ROLE

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. 
For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


About the role 

At Nubank, we challenge the status quo to strengthen our ownership of risk management, aligning global and local processes with our strategic objectives. The Third Party Risk Management Expert role plays an essential part in this context, responsible for coordinating and monitoring the risks associated with vendors that support Nubank's operations globally.

The main objective is to ensure that third parties critical to the business are properly assessed, monitored, and managed, promoting operational continuity, information security, and regulatory compliance. This function will also connect business areas, Procurement, and risk assessment teams, ensuring that the third-party lifecycle happens in a secure, efficient, and standardized way. The role has global scope, covering the locations where Nubank operates and future expansion geographies, with direct interface with different regulatory regimes and active banking licenses.

 - Defining global guidelines for third-party risk management.

 - Architecting and evolving Nubank's global TPRM model, including qualification methodology, criticality criteria, and control framework by risk domain.

 - Evaluating and deciding on the adequacy of vendor controls, triggering enhanced due diligence processes based on the regulatory context of each jurisdiction.

 - Leading the expansion of the TPRM framework into new geographies, ensuring the model is adapted to local regulatory requirements from pre-launch.

 - Governing and guiding the development of an AI-powered vendor qualification platform, being responsible for process design and human validation of generated recommendations.

 - Determining and maintaining Nubank's TPRM RACI, ensuring clarity of roles and responsibilities across involved areas.

 - Defining the minimum requirements and baseline of TPRM controls to be followed across all geographies, ensuring global consistency and alignment.

 - Conducting continuous monitoring of critical third parties, tracking indicators, incidents, and action plans.

 - Consolidating information on third parties and their risks, providing a global and integrated view for Nubank's forums and governance.

 - Collaborating with risk domains and stakeholders to define and review controls, processes, and vendor assessment criteria.

 - Generating and monitoring Key Risk Indicators that represent third-party risk status globally.

 - Representing TPRM as a 2nd Line of Defense function before regulators and auditors (BCB, CNBV, SFC, FFIEC/OCC, FMA), acting as the technical point of contact for exams and questions on vendor methodology and controls.

 - Coordinating RCSA processes and executing Risk Assessment & Internal Control Testing (RA&ICT) activities within the TPRM scope.

What we are looking for 

 - Is autonomous and interested in working in a dynamic environment with constant interaction across different areas and countries.

 - Has analytical thinking and curiosity to deeply understand how third parties operate and their business impact.

 - Has prior experience with third-party risk management and familiarity with risk frameworks.

 - Has strong communication skills and the ability to translate technical risk into clear messages for different audiences.

 - Is data-driven, with the ability to analyze metrics and propose evidence-based solutions.

 - Has solid ability to influence without formal authority, capable of challenging methodologies and practices across business areas, risk domains, and regulatory stakeholders in multiple geographies.

 - Has proven experience managing complex, multidisciplinary projects, with the ability to orchestrate simultaneous deliverables in highly ambiguous contexts with multiple regulators.

 - Is familiar with AI applied to risk management, including critical evaluation of model outputs, human-in-the-loop process design, and governance of automations in regulated contexts.

 - Has advanced English.

jobs.title: Global Head of Brand & Creative
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE TEAM

This is a build role. Nubank is standing up its first Global Creative & Brand Foundations Center of Excellence (CoE): a central hub sets best practices, capacity planning, and quality measurement, while markets retain execution. You'll be defining the operating model as you go, in close partnership with Senior Leadership and the regional creative leadership.

The mandate is specific: Brand Foundations and the Creative Center of Excellence. Own the craft and brand disciplines globally and Execution stays local. Brand Foundations is a small, Brazil-based team (currently three to four people) that has owned Nubank's brand refresh, sonic identity, and institutional design system; Nubank's institutional brand work globally is also moving into this role's remit. Your job is to build the system, standards, career paths, hiring bar, tooling, and review cadence, that lets creative and brand quality hold as Nubank multiplies markets and headcount.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This role owns Brand and Creative globally for Nubank — not an advisory function reviewing guidelines from the sidelines, but full, end-to-end accountability for how the brand shows up everywhere Nubank operates.

The mandate centers on two things:

 - Setting the creative and brand bar. Define what "great" looks like concretely enough that regional teams can hold themselves to it, rather than relying on a single senior reviewer to catch problems after the fact.

 - Building the infrastructure behind great creative work — tooling, review cadence, and governance — so quality can scale without linear headcount growth.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Hiring bar & talent. Set and protect the hiring bar for creative talent in every market where Nubank hires. Recruit senior creative leaders and stay closely involved in senior creative hires as the Center of Excellence builds out. Coach and seniorize existing creative talent over time, particularly in Brazil.

 - Scalable tooling. Build the tools and workflows — including AI-assisted ones — that let creative quality scale without linear headcount growth.

 - Review cadence & governance. Run a structured, content-focused creative review cadence that replaces today's ad hoc, adversarial feedback loops between markets and leadership.

 - Creative direction beyond the traditional campaign. Push the creative product past efficiency-driven, format-first advertising toward earned media and content built to be genuinely watched, not just placed.

Core Workstreams

 1. Brand Foundations — Own brand refresh, sonic identity, and the institutional design system, plus Nubank's institutional brand presence company-wide, in close partnership with Cristina Junqueira.

 2. Creative Center of Excellence — Own creative output company-wide: campaigns, social content, influencer marketing, and marketing stunts. Set the creative and brand bar that lets regional teams hold themselves to a consistent standard — distinct from media planning and channel measurement, which remain with regional teams.

 3. Creative Production & Agency Management — Build an in-house production capability and direct the roster of external creative agencies.


QUALIFICATIONS

Professional Experience & Education

 - 10+ years in creative or brand leadership, with a track record of setting standards across multiple markets or business units — not just producing work for one.

 - Demonstrated experience building the infrastructure behind good creative (career ladders, review processes, hiring bars), not only a portfolio of campaigns.

 - Agency or in-house creative director background; strong agency-side creative leadership experience is a plus.

 - Fintech or financial services experience is useful context, though not required.

 - A clear point of view on how AI tools change the economics of creative production at scale, with genuine appetite to build with them rather than bolt them on.

Competencies & Attributes

 - Comfortable operating inside a matrixed, multi-market organization, with the judgment to raise the craft bar without steamrolling the local teams who own execution.

 - Experience developing junior and mid-level creative talent into senior roles, including hands-on coaching of raw talent toward more refined execution.

 - Strong systems-thinking orientation: able to build the structure behind creative work (leveling, tooling, governance), not only produce it personally.

 - Comfortable working across English- and Portuguese-speaking teams, given close, regular collaboration with Brazil-based creative talent and leadership.

jobs.title: Head of Total Rewards
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en



We're now entering our next growth cycle — accelerating internationalization beyond Latin America and expanding into new verticals beyond financial services.

Here's the question this role exists to answer: as Nubank moves from a Latin American digital bank into a globally distributed company operating across dozens of jurisdictions and new verticals - competing simultaneously for regulated banking talent and frontier tech talent - how do we build a Rewards architecture that scales without fragmenting, stays competitive, efficient & effective, and reinforces a single culture across radically different labor markets?

The frameworks that took us from zero to over 135M customers across three countries are not the frameworks that will take us to 40+ markets. You will be the person who decides what scales, what gets rebuilt, and what gets retired.

Why this matters: Compensation, benefits, equity, and executive pay are the contracts we write with every person we hire - and at our scale, those contracts are also the operating system that determines where we can grow, how fast, and at what cost. This isn't a function that administers programs handed down by the business. It's the function that decides what's possible.




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

You will lead global compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation end-to-end, sit on the Executive Committee, and partner directly with our CEO and CHRO on the most consequential people decisions we make: site location strategy, M&A diligence, market entry, AI transformation, and the deals that secure the leaders defining Nubank's next chapter.

 - Design the global Rewards architecture - compensation, benefits, wellness, and executive compensation - coherent globally, adaptable locally, built to scale from 3 markets to 40+.

 - Partner on globalization and M&A, including site location, deal structuring, and post-merger integration. Bring the Rewards lens on the right talent strategy across the globe.

 - Operate at the People leadership team partnering directly with the CEO and CHRO on executive compensation, equity design, and senior leadership talent strategy.

 - Own the relationship with our Compensation Committee chair and Board members on executive comp and governance.

 - Lead with data - assess effectiveness, guide design, and demonstrate impact in language the business understands.

 - Shape the people implications of AI transformation - how AI changes job architecture, critical talent needs, workforce planning, and the reward mechanisms that reinforce the capabilities Nubank needs next.

 - Build and develop your team, fostering ownership and continuous improvement in a high-velocity environment.

Rewards is the non-negotiable core of this role. Depending on your background, scope may also extend into other disciplines.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 10+ years leading global Total Rewards functions in complex, multi-country environments.

 - Deep expertise in compensation, benefits, and executive compensation design.

 - Experience in high-growth or tech-driven organizations - you know what breaks when a company scales fast.

 - A track record leading large-scale organizational change through complex, cross-functional projects.

 - The communication range to make complex trade-offs clear and compelling to a C-level and Board audience.

 - A strategic, data-driven mindset - and the operational discipline to actually ship the work, not just design it.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Our Procurement team

Our Procurement team exists to support, influence, and challenge business decisions by delivering value across end-to-end sourcing processes through long-term, sustainable partnerships, enabled by efficient, agile, and innovative ways of working.

Our ambition is bold: to build one of the best and least bureaucratic Procurement teams in the technology space, driving cost efficiency through strategic partnerships and a highly skilled, diverse, and engaged team.

About the role

We are looking for a Procurement Specialist to help accelerate Nubank’s business expansion in the United States. This role can be based in Palo Alto, California, or Miami, Florida.

You will act as a key partner to the business, helping shape sourcing and contracting decisions with a strong focus on financial impact, risk mitigation, process efficiency, and early adoption of AI in Procurement routines. You will report to the Senior Manager of Procurement and will work across contracts and multiple categories in a highly cross-functional environment.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who enjoys combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution, navigating local market dynamics and regulatory requirements, and building scalable solutions that support a fast-growing business. We are looking for someone who is energized by using AI and digital tools to improve visibility, decision-making, stakeholder experience, and vendor performance management.

You will be responsible for

 - Developing robust negotiation strategies and cost targets by leveraging market dynamics, benchmarks, and key category trends.

 - Managing strategic and relevant sourcing categories while building strong relationships with internal stakeholders and suppliers.

 - Leading and supporting sourcing and contracting initiatives that strengthen financial outcomes, improve existing processes, and enable business scalability.

 - Acting as a trusted Procurement partner for US business needs, ensuring local demands and contracting approaches are aligned with applicable regulatory and legal requirements.

 - Driving consistency and high-quality execution across contracting and supplier management practices, while influencing stakeholders across functions and geographies.

 - Identifying risks early and implementing mitigation strategies throughout the sourcing and contract lifecycle.

 - Using data, technology, analytical tools, and AI-enabled solutions to improve category management, decision-making, and Procurement visibility.

 - Driving early adoption of AI in Procurement routines, using AI tools to optimize team workflows, increase productivity, and improve the quality and speed of execution.

 - Leveraging AI and digital solutions to support performance management across routines, stakeholder interactions, supplier governance, and vendor relationship management.

 - Building and maintaining dashboards and visual management mechanisms that provide clear visibility into financial impact, risks, deadlines, pipeline status, and sourcing performance.

 - Analyzing budgets, spending patterns, supplier opportunities, and operational signals to uncover efficiency gains and better commercial outcomes.

 - Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives that simplify processes, reduce friction, and strengthen Procurement’s operating model.

We are looking for someone who has

 - 5+ years of experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Vendor Management, or Contract Management, ideally in fast-paced, technology-driven, or highly regulated environments.

 - Strong negotiation and sourcing skills, with the ability to balance business ambition, commercial value, and risk management.

 - Experience working across multiple categories and managing contracts in partnership with Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders.

 - Strong business judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to translate data into practical recommendations and action plans.

 - Experience using AI tools and digital solutions to improve routines, productivity, quality of deliverables, and visibility for decision-making.

 - Experience building, structuring, or using dashboards and visual management tools to track financial impact, risks, deadlines, and performance.

 - A hands-on mindset and a genuine interest in improving processes, creating scalable solutions, and increasing operational efficiency.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence clearly and objectively across seniority levels.

 - Strong prioritization and project management skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and move quickly without losing quality.

 - Advanced proficiency in English.

Why this role is special

This is a high-impact role for someone who wants to help build Procurement capabilities in a strategic growth market while helping shape a more AI-enabled way of working. You will have the chance to work on meaningful business decisions, influence cross-functional stakeholders, strengthen vendor and stakeholder management through smarter routines, and help design scalable processes that combine speed, governance, financial discipline, and better visibility of risks and deadlines.

jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

About the Role

Growing fast in a regulated market only works when compliance is a partner, not a gate. In our Mexico Compliance team, you'll make sure the products millions of customers use every day are built on solid regulatory ground, from the first design conversation, not after launch.

You'll sit closest to the teams doing the building and own the regulatory view for your assigned areas. Product, engineering, fraud, and operations will come to you with real decisions: can we launch this, how do we structure it, what does the regulator expect?

Your job is to turn dense regulation into answers people can act on, and to be accountable for the quality of the guidance Nu builds on.

 

You'll be responsible for

 - Partner with product, engineering, and design teams to embed Mexican regulatory requirements into new products and features before they ship.

 - Translate CNBV, Banxico, and CONDUSEF regulation into clear, actionable guidance that non-compliance teams can build against.

 - Advise fraud, operations, and customer experience teams on the regulatory obligations shaping their processes and controls.

 - Own the regulatory assessment for your assigned areas: identify applicable requirements, flag gaps, and drive them to resolution with accountable owners.

 - Monitor regulatory change in Mexico, assess its impact across the product and operations roadmap, and turn new requirements into concrete work.

 - Build reusable playbooks and decision frameworks so teams can self-serve on recurring regulatory questions.

 - Represent Compliance in cross-functional forums, escalating risk decisions with a clear point of view and a recommendation.

 - Shape how the Compliance function scales with the business by improving how advisory work is prioritized, documented, and measured.

 

We are looking for a person who has

Required

 - Experience in regulatory compliance, legal, or risk within financial services in Mexico: banking, fintech, SOFIPO, or a regulator.

 - Working knowledge of Mexico's financial regulatory framework, including CNBV, Banxico, and CONDUSEF.

 - A track record of advising non-legal audiences, such as product managers, engineers, and operations leads, and becoming the person they seek out.

 - The ability to turn dense regulation into simple, decision-ready guidance without losing precision.

 - Comfort operating in ambiguity and making judgment calls where regulation is silent or open to interpretation.

 - Experience influencing cross-functional teams without formal authority.

 - Professional fluency in Spanish and English.

Nice to have

 - Exposure to regulatory reporting, requirements, or inspections from CNBV, CONDUSEF, or Banxico.

 - Experience in a high-growth technology company or inside a scaling compliance function.

 - Familiarity with credit, payments, or deposit products in the Mexican market.

jobs.title: IT Risk Management Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT NU

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page https://www.nu.com/2026-en


ABOUT THE ROLE 

This position sits within Nubank’s global risk management team and provides second-line oversight of technology and information security risks across Nubank’s global systems, platforms, and processes. You will work closely with Engineering, Information Security, Data, Product, Business, and local Risk Management teams to identify, assess, and govern technology risks while enabling the company to grow safely and at speed.

The role combines hands-on risk assessment with stakeholder partnership, risk monitoring, control oversight, incident follow-up, and continuous improvement of IT Risk practices. You will help apply global frameworks and methodologies consistently across geographies, while considering local regulatory requirements and the characteristics of each technology environment.



YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR 

 - Conduct IT and cybersecurity risk assessments across technology domains, platforms, products, features, and critical processes, identifying threats, vulnerabilities, potential impacts, and appropriate risk responses.

 - Assess and challenge technology risks associated with new products, features, systems, infrastructure, and material changes, helping teams identify and address risks early in the lifecycle.

 - Partner with Engineering, Information Security, Data, Product, Business, and local Risk Management teams to develop mitigation plans aligned with risk appetite, global standards, and applicable regulatory requirements.

 - Support the implementation and consistent application of global IT Risk frameworks, methodologies, policies, procedures, metrics, and governance practices across Nubank’s operations.

 - Implement, mMonitor and analyse Key Risk Indicators, metrics, and dashboards for technology and cybersecurity risks, identifying changes in risk exposure and escalating matters that require attention.

 - Prepare clear risk assessments, reports, and recommendations for technical stakeholders, senior management, governance forums, and risk committees.

 - Support independent control testing and the assessment of control effectiveness, documenting gaps and recommending practical risk mitigants and action plans.

 - Monitor technology, cybersecurity, and data-platform incidents; contribute to root-cause analysis, assess systemic implications, and connect remediation plans to the risk governance framework.

 - Provide IT and cybersecurity risk expertise for third-party services, cloud environments, APIs, telecommunications infrastructure, and other technology dependencies.

 - Monitor regulatory developments, emerging threats, technology changes, and industry practices, assessing their implications for Nubank’s IT Risk posture.

 - Contribute to risk-related inquiries, workshops, thematic reviews, and governance routines, translating technical topics into actionable risk guidance.

 - Identify opportunities to improve the efficiency, consistency, and scalability of IT Risk activities through data analytics, workflow automation, AI platforms, and other technology-enabled approaches.

 - Support the development of junior colleagues and contribute to the continuous improvement of the team’s practices, tools, and methodologies.
   

What We're Looking For Someone Who Has

 - Strong experience in technology areas, information security, IT risk management, internal controls or another risk-heavy technical role.

 - Solid understanding of modern technology environments, including information security fundamentals, cloud-native environments such as AWS and GCP, microservices, APIs, CI/CD pipelines, containers, serverless technologies, and distributed systems.

 - Strong grounding in risk assessment, risk analysis, mitigation planning, control effectiveness, incident management, risk monitoring, and governance reporting.

 - Familiarity with risk and security frameworks and regulatory expectations, such as NIST, ISO/IEC 27001, LGPD, and applicable financial-services requirements.

 - Ability to translate complex technical topics into clear business and risk-oriented insights for audiences with different levels of technical knowledge and seniority.

 - Constructive-challenge mindset, with the ability to remain independent while building effective partnerships with first-line teams.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to structure ambiguous situations, prioritise risks, and make sound risk-based recommendations.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

 - Ability to work effectively across global and local teams, geographies, functions, and lines of defence.

 - Pragmatic and collaborative approach to risk management, balancing robust controls with simplicity, speed, and customer focus.

 - Strong ownership, organisation, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Business, or a related field.

 - Relevant experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, IT risk management, information security, internal controls, or a related area.

 - Demonstrated experience working with technology teams and evaluating risks across cloud environments, applications, infrastructure, data platforms, or third-party services.

 - Experience contributing to risk frameworks, policies, control assessments, KRIs, incident management, regulatory responses, or risk governance processes.

 - Experience in a regulated financial institution or fintech is a plus.

 - Experience working across countries, global technology teams, or multiple regulatory environments is a plus.

 - Relevant certifications such as CISA, CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CHE, ISO 27001, or equivalent are a plus.

 - Advanced English communication skills, both written and verbal, are essential for this global role.
